861:t_070:11.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A game is something you play to enjoy, after all.」

861:t_071:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$五飛$$, tell me. How many more stages do we have to clear?」

861:t_071:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How many more times do we have to continue...? $$ゼロ$$ won't tell me anything... Tell me, $$五飛$$.」

861:t_071:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Are you saying that will happen again... all over?」

861:t_072:3.en:
$$カトル$$
「So you're pausing the game here. That's a wise call, just like you.」

861:t_072:4.en:
$$カトル$$
「Just don't let the fighting wear you down until you lose sight of your own heart, please.」

861:t_072:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「Rest up well and get back to your usual self. See you again!」

861:t_073:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Why abort the mission? If you don't come back right this instant, I'll ki...」

861:t_073:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Cut it out, $$ヒイロ$$. Don't put a player in the same boat as a guy with your superhuman stamina.」

861:t_073:5.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If you don't do everything in moderation, you'll end up like these two.」

861:t_073:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「So you'd get in my way. Then... die!」

861:t_073:7.en:
$$五飛$$
「If a greater evil appears, the player will come back! Then I will become that evil!」

861:t_073:8.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...So that's how it is, so go easy on the games!」

861:t_073:9.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Well then, until we meet again.」

861:t_074:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Players, everyone. Super Robot Wars is a game that really makes you want to see what happens next!」

861:t_074:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Super Robot Wars is a game that really makes you want to see what happens next!」

861:t_075:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「People living on another planet came from far across space, attacked, and invaded Earth.」

861:t_075:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「To stop a great war that warps people's hearts, I decide to ride a mobile suit once more.」

861:t_075:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I just hope we can somehow take Earth back...」

861:t_075:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Next time, 'The Stolen Earth'. A wind that shook the dimensions blew...」

861:t_076:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「From the words of someone claiming to be an emissary of God, I learned that humanity is about to be destroyed.」

861:t_076:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The feelings of the many people who wish for peace come together and grow into a great power.」

861:t_076:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And so we made up our minds...!」

861:t_076:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Next time, 'The Golden Galaxy'. The wind crosses the dimensions...」

861:t_077:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$! $$ティファ$$, come on! Hey, come over here and say a few last words!」

861:t_077:5.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...Please... promise me. Promise me you'll come back, no matter what. So that this fighting can end quickly, too...」

861:t_077:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're lucky to get a message from $$ティファ$$, pal! I guarantee you good luck!」

861:t_077:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Luck, like the Moon, is always there! Okay, see ya!」

861:t_078:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Game over... there. Now then... time to go see $$ティファ$$.」

861:t_078:4.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Don't get cocky, $$ガロード・ラン$$. If you think everything will go as you wish, you are gravely mistaken.」

861:t_078:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You don't have to tell me that, I know. Even so, I'll live on with $$ティファ$$.」

861:t_078:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You should be more honest too. Life's more fun when you're true to your own feelings.」

861:t_078:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See ya, everyone playing. We only live once, so let's live with no regrets.」

861:t_078:9.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Well then, until we meet again.」

861:t_079:3.en:
$$シン$$
「You're stopping here? Then I guess I'll take a break too.」

861:t_079:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Fight when it's time to fight, rest when you can rest... But make sure you come back, okay?」

861:t_079:5.en:
$$シン$$
「You and us, fighting together. That's the only way to grab peace, after all.」

861:t_080:3.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That's it for this mission.」

861:t_080:4.en:
$$シン$$
「You players take a good rest too, okay?」

861:t_080:5.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Huh? You're not going to say stuff like 'What are you thinking?!'...?」

861:t_080:7.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Before, you were all like, 'Quitting the game at a point like this? I won't!'」

861:t_080:8.en:
$$シン$$
「D-don't bring up the past! Come on... let's greet the players together.」

861:t_080:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Yes, yes. Well then, everyone...」

861:t_081:3.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$キラ$$... How long are we going to keep fighting, I wonder...」

861:t_081:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$... That's for us to decide, ourselves and all of you playing.」

861:t_081:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「'3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen'... Let's fight too, to bring it all to an end.」

861:t_081:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「The final battle of the long-running 'Z' series... Please lend us your feelings and your strength, players.」

861:t_081:8.en:
$$アスラン$$
「We're waiting for everyone to come back. Fight alongside us again.」

861:t_082:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「The fighting goes on. But beyond it, there must surely be peace.」

861:t_082:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「When you clear this '3rd Super Robot Wars Z', I believe peace is what awaits there.」

861:t_082:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「That's why I will fight alongside you. Until we meet again.」

861:t_083:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Casting off the mask... I never knew it would feel this good.」

861:t_083:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Exactly. Cast off the past, cast off the false self, and the whole heart is set free.」

861:t_083:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「And that is precisely why a new trial awaits there.」

861:t_083:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But we must not fear it.」

861:t_083:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Players, cast off the masks of your hearts too, and live true to yourselves.」

861:t_083:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「And let us meet again. In this '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'.」

861:t_084:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The 'Super Robot Wars Z' series is finally coming to an end, huh...」

861:t_084:4.en:
$$シン$$
「We've known each other a long time, you and me.」

861:t_084:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「True. When we first met, I wondered how it would turn out...」

861:t_084:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I'm glad. That I got to fight alongside you and all the players.」

861:t_084:8.en:
$$シン$$
「It's too early for lines like that. The fighting isn't over yet.」

861:t_084:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're right. You, me, and all the players will fight to the end together.」

861:t_085:3.en:
$$くらら$$
「Casting Strike, Valor, Alert, Luck, and Gain, and then...」

861:t_085:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I wondered where you'd gone, and you're here playing games...!」

861:t_085:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Heeey~ what do we have here...? 'Super Robot Wars Z'?」

861:t_085:6.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Well then, allow me to share some useful info with you!」
